label: s2_side01_0090_system_01
text: Hm? There’s something in this planter...

label: s2_side01_0090_system_02
text: You found the remote control for the TV!

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_01
text: What! No way! That means you get to choose\nwhat we do![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Wowzers!
’Course
you
found
it
first,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_01
text: Hey, friend. You agree with me that we should\nuse that big ol’ screen to play games, riiight?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_02
text: Huh? Where’d Nemona go off to? She in the\nbathroom or something?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_02
text: No, I was checking around there earlier—I’m\npretty sure I would’ve seen her go in.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_02
text: She didn’t head into the rooms in the back either.\nI was by the door to the hallway this whole time.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_03
text: I think I know what’s going on...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_04
text: She must be waiting to jump out and scare us![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_03
text: Hmm. I tried her phone, but she’s not picking up.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_05
text: You tried calling her?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_06
text: I didn’t hear her phone ring or anything. That’s...\nweird.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_04
text: Huh...that is weird.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_03
text: So...does that help us figure out where she is?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_select_01
text: She’s probably outside

label: s2_side01_0080_select_02
text: She’s not here, at least

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_05
text: Hmmm...maybe she was so set on finding that\nremote that she went outdoors to look for it?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_07
text: I guess that’d make sense...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_04
text: Maybe she forgot to get something at the shop?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_05
text: I just hope she didn’t wander out of town...\c\nKitakami’s dangerous at night if you don’t know\nyour way around.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_06
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]...I think [VAR 0x0100(0000)] and I should
go
look
outside.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_07
text: Arven, Penny—can you two stay here for now?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_brother_08
text: What if she comes back while we’re all out? We\nhave a better chance of finding her if you stay\r\nhere, and you can call us if she does.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_09
text: That’s true... OK! But be careful out there![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_06
text: We’ll hold down the fort till you get back.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0080_friend_npc
text: Be careful! It’s already pretty dark outside.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0080_botan_npc
text: I hope Nemona’s all right...\c\nAll that talk about curses made my hair stand on\nend...seriously, worse than a Jolteon’s![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
